purpose: q4/q5: historical S3/S4 buyback-burn and dilution estimates

findings.claim: Tokenomist deep dive (2025-12-23, pre-June-2026 upgrade): S3 fees >$280M, ~155.7M bought back, 77.86M burned (50% of buybacks; ~3.28% of circ supply); S4 60-90% of fees to buybacks from early Dec 2025; model then: 50% burned / 50% to community-airdrop reserves; initial circulating ~1.6B (20.75%) incl. 706M airdrop + 360M liquidity; airdrop phases: P1 8.8%/704M done, Stage 2 4%/~320M done, Stage 3 ~2.5%/~200M not live; then-projected dilution +27% 1y, +120% 4y; insider emissions 0% until Sep 18 2026 (since extended to 2027-09-17 per docs)

lessons: Article predates the Jun 2026 upgrade and team-cliff extension - treat as historical snapshot, superseded by docs.706M vs 704M airdrop discrepancy; 706+360=1.07B not 1.6B (likely includes APX swap) - internal inconsistency
reuse_hint: use for season history only
